messages:
Marta (oncall): hey team :wave: i'm taking the overnight primary handoff at 20:00UTC. quick checklist before i go fully dark: primary=me, secondary=raj. raj — can you confirm you have PagerDuty:Respond and PagerDuty:Escalate?

Raj: i have basic PD alerts but not escalate perms. i can ack/fire notifications but cant escalate or reassign. pinged pd-admins a bit ago.

Marta (oncall): ok that's the first gap. Simon, can you check PD role for raj? the runbook references `pd:respond` vs `pd:escalate` roles — we need escalate.

Simon: on it. quick way to check is `pd roles:list` in the admin console or look at the user in the PD web UI. will do now.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled handoff window starting 20:00UTC (duration 12h). Relevant runbooks: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/oncall/handoff and https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/incidents/pagerduty-escalation

Marta (oncall): also we need AWS console assume-role access for jaeger/grafana: raj needs `arn:aws:iam::012345678901:role/OncallReadOnly` and `arn:aws:iam::012345678901:role/OncallAssumeEmergency` for creds. if you only have read-only you can't rotate instances or pull credentials if an infra mitigation is needed.

Raj: i only have OncallReadOnly. i can't assume the emergency role. how do i request assume-role?

Alex (eng-oncall-lead): Raj — file a quick ticket in internal IT with the subject "AWS assume-role for oncall" and CC eng-oncall. Security will review. If you need immediate access for this shift, @jenna can temporarily grant assume-role via Okta session elevation.

Jenna (security): i can do a temporary elevation for tonight. i need Raj's okta username and the justification (oncall). i will add a 4h timebound policy. please confirm you accept the audit logs.

Raj: username raj.patel. confirming i accept audit logs. need it by 20:15UTC.

Jenna (security): noted. i'm initiating a temporary grant now. you should see an Okta prompt to accept MFA. after acceptance i'll add the AWS role into your Okta app.

Simon: PD check complete — Raj did not have `Escalate` scope. I opened PD ticket #PD-2327 to add `Escalate` to raj.patel. PD-admins tagged @pd-admins. ETA unknown but requested expedited for handoff.

Marta (oncall): thanks. while PD change propagates, add this workaround in runbook: if secondary lacks escalate, primary should reassign incidents to an on-call admin or escalate via the escalation policy manually (link below). put this under "handoff gaps".

Marta (oncall): Grafana — i noticed raj doesn't have edit/view-permissions for the `prod-slo` dashboard. need at least Dashboard Viewer and ability to see annotations. Can someone confirm grafana org role?

Simon: grafana shows raj as "Viewer" on org level but not member of `prod-monitoring` team. I'll add him to the team — should sync in ~60s.

oncall-bot: Deploy alert (minor): service/routing proxied 2xx->500 errors spike at 19:52UTC — not actionable, testing only.

Raj: accepted Okta prompt, can see temporary role now. i can assume `OncallAssumeEmergency`. testing `aws sts get-caller-identity` returns the assume-role ARN.

Raj: can confirm Grafana dashboard access now. can see `prod-slo` and annotations. PD still pending but i can at least ack alerts.

Marta (oncall): great. PD escalate still TBD — Alex, do we want to nominate a backup escalator (someone in eng-oncall-admins) who can step in if PD perms don't finish?

Alex (eng-oncall-lead): nominate Simon as backup escalator for the overnight. Simon, you ok to take escalate if PD change doesn't finish?

Simon: i can. also uploaded a small snippet to the runbook under Handoff -> Temporary Escalation:

```
# Temporary escalation steps
1. Primary reassign incident to eng-oncall-admins (PD group)
2. If reassign fails, open PD incident and call escalation policy via phone tree
3. Update thread and runbook with mitigation note
```

Marta (oncall): thanks. i'm going to update the handoff thread in the runbook with the exact time windows and permissions gaps. note for coverage: APAC coverage is light from 02:00-06:00UTC; if an incident starts then please follow the APAC fallback policy in runbook.

Jenna (security): PD change complete — i confirmed PD-admins added `Escalate` for raj.patel. PD ticket PD-2327 resolved. audit log entry ID: AZ-99821.

Marta (oncall): awesome. thanks @jenna and @simon for the quick moves. raj — can you do one final smoke-check: ack + escalate a test incident (use test policy) so we verify end-to-end?

Raj: performed test: ack succeeded, escalate succeeded, and Grafana annotations posted.

Marta (oncall): perfect. final notes added to runbook: (1) temporary Okta elevation policy used, (2) PD escalate added, (3) grafana team membership adjusted. i linked the ticket IDs. leaving primary to Raj at 20:20UTC — i'm going offline. good handoff :thumbsup:

Raj: taking primary. thanks Marta. i'll post if anything fires.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: primary=Raj, secondary=Marta, handoff_ts=2003124120, recorded_by=oncall-bot."
